questions.q: Which Indian state recently launched the nation’s first AI-powered Anganwadi centre?
questions.explain: Maharashtra has taken a pioneering step by inaugurating India’s first AI-powered Anganwadi in Waddhamna village, Nagpur district, under the Mission Bal Bharari initiative. This innovative approach aims to modernize early childhood education using technology like AI and VR in rural areas.

questions.q: What action has the Kerala High Court recently ordered for the conservation of the Ashtamudi Wetland?
options: Formation of a dedicated management unit and conservation plan
Total ban on fishing in the lake
Installation of smart meters for water usage
questions.explain: The Kerala High Court has directed the state government and the State Wetland Authority Kerala (SWAK) to establish a dedicated Ashtamudi Wetland Management Unit and prepare an integrated conservation plan, in response to severe ecological degradation of the wetland.

questions.q: What is the total amount of grant-in-aid approved by the Union Cabinet for the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC)?

It offers employment opportunities in EU countries
